title: finding(core,i18n): two DECLARED locale contracts give opposite guidance for a non-React caller with no tag — `undefined` is "the honest answer" in one and the wrong answer in the other
body:
Path: P2 | 那条路第 2 步「本地跑起来、看到」 | 两份**已声明**的 locale 契约,对「无标签的非 React 调用方」给出相反指引
分诊重测与定级:2026-09-20T15:58Z

Dedupe words: `two locale contracts disagree non-React caller` · `useDisplayLocale contract undefined wrong answer` · `number-display undefined means machine locale` · `formatNumberInLocale RangeError retry` · `malformed locale retry drops tag`

Surfaced by the objectui#10020 dev while threading a display locale through `@object-ui/plugin-report`; it declined to act on it and declined to widen into `packages/core`, which is correct. ⛔ No `priority:*` / `type` here — the triage seat's sole production. `domain:ui` inherited from the in-flight parent objectui#10020.

## ⭐ Two DECLARED contracts, read first-hand by this seat on `origin/main`, giving opposite guidance for the same case

**`@object-ui/core`, `packages/core/src/utils/number-display.ts:58`** — on `DisplayNumberFormatOptions.locale`:

> `undefined` means "follow the runtime default", which is the honest answer for a non-React caller that has no locale in hand. It never means `en-US`: assuming US conventions for the whole world is the defect this module was created to remove.

**`@object-ui/i18n`, `packages/i18n/src/useDisplayLocale.ts:32-34`**:

> **`'en'`** — a concrete last resort rather than `undefined`. `undefined` would hand `Intl` the *machine's* locale, which is invisible in review and non-deterministic in CI; `'en'` at least fails the same way everywhere.

⇒ For the case that actually arises — **a non-React caller with no tag in hand** — one document calls `undefined` the honest answer and the other calls handing `Intl` an absent tag the wrong answer, for a reason (non-determinism in CI, invisibility in review) that applies to exactly that caller. ⭐ Both are prose a reader is meant to follow, and both are in force.

## ⚠️ The split between what this seat measured and what it did not

- ⭐ **自量**: the two quotations above and their addresses. Read in the act that filed this card.
- ⚠️ **转述, ⛔ NOT re-run by this seat**: the objectui#10020 dev's further reading that `formatNumberInLocale`'s malformed-tag retry **drops the tag**, so a tenant with a typo'd locale (an underscore instead of a hyphen — the file's own comment calls that the likeliest tenant-config typo) silently renders every dataset measure in the **runner's** locale. ⇒ ⭐ the taking dev re-takes this leg first; it is the part that turns a documentation conflict into a user-visible one, and it deserves its own measurement rather than this card's word.

## Why it is worth a card rather than a comment

An author or a later dev reading either document gets a rule, follows it, and is following the other one's ⛔ refusal. ⚠️ ⛔ This is NOT a request to change behaviour in either package: the two may well be reconcilable — `core` is genuinely about a caller that has no tag at all, `i18n` about one that is resolving a display locale and could have one. ⭐ **Deciding whether they reconcile is the deliverable**, and whichever way it goes, the losing document gets a sentence saying so, so the next reader does not re-derive the conflict.

⛔ The objectui#10020 dev deliberately did NOT resolve it in that PR, and ⛔ deliberately did not widen into `packages/core`. Its change degrades to `'en'` and says so in the code — which is one of the two answers, taken locally, ⛔ not a ruling for the repo.

## ⛔ What this card does NOT claim

- ⛔ Not that either package is wrong today. Both contracts are declared and each is defensible on its own surface.
- ⛔ Not that objectui#10020's local choice (`'en'`) is wrong — it followed the `i18n` contract, which is the one its own package consumes.
- ⛔ Not that any user has been hit. ⚠️ Nothing measures a tenant with a malformed tag; the user-visible half is the 转述 leg above and is unmeasured.

## Acceptance

- The two documents give ONE answer for a non-React caller with no tag, and the one that yields carries a sentence naming the other.
- ⭐ The malformed-tag retry's behaviour is re-measured first-hand, with a control in the same command (a well-formed tag through the same path, so a zero is a reading). If it does drop the tag, whether that is the intended degradation is part of the same answer.
- ⛔ No second locale channel is introduced, and ⛔ no `en-US` is reintroduced anywhere as a default.
